facts.fact: Countdown to 2030, with the Ministry of Health, gives no count or share of facilities entering their own reports; it puts completeness of monthly facility reporting in DHIS2 (mean of ANC, delivery and immunisation forms) at 97% of expected reports nationally in 2025, up from 83% in 2020, with 95% of districts at 90% or more, and an annual data-quality score of 87 against 73 in 2020.

systems.tiers: health facilities, reporting monthly; tiers not stated
